declaredIdentity: UUIDv5 tenant+normalized sourceWorkerId chosen by handler; initial person/terms compare. Constructor accepts arbitrary id but route uses IdFor. Revise exact retry stale under expectedRevision.
invariant: One stable source worker ID belongs permanently to one person; end date/status and sponsor/self-manager constraints must form valid governed relationship at each revision.
boundaryRationale: Immutable worker-person identity and lifecycle terms must cohere; workforce roster/history belongs projection.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: caller-supplied immutable creation identity: an exact retry with the same id and authored intent returns the original result; the same id with changed intent is refused; a different id is a different record
CommandId binds one immutable authored intent to the exact owner identity and expected revision: an exact retry returns the original result, a changed intent under the same CommandId is refused

baselineIdentityObservation: UUIDv5 tenant+normalized sourceWorkerId chosen by handler; initial person/terms compare. Constructor accepts arbitrary id but route uses IdFor. Revise exact retry stale under expectedRevision.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Existing tenant-scoped UUIDv5 of normalized SourceWorkerId. Supplied RelationshipId must equal that unchanged algorithm; selected revisions use CommandId with exact person/membership/source-worker binding.
selectedIdentitySummary: Existing tenant-scoped UUIDv5 of normalized SourceWorkerId. Supplied RelationshipId must equal that unchanged algorithm; selected revisions use CommandId with exact person/membership/source-worker binding.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

productRules.rule: A workforce person requires a stable worker identifier, display name, work email, worker type (employee, contractor, external collaborator), lifecycle status, start and end dates, direct manager, and department or team; a manual roster uses an organization-maintained worker identifier, and an external source identifier is provenance only.
An external collaborator with access to a reviewed system must be recorded as a workforce person of type external collaborator with an accountable internal sponsor.

decides: A relationship requires a person, worker type employee, contractor or external_collaborator, status pending, active, on_leave or ended, an end date when ended not before the start date, and department at most 200 characters; nobody may be their own manager or sponsor, and an external collaborator requires an accountable internal sponsor. A manual roster uses an organization-maintained worker identifier with any external source identifier as provenance only.
